verdict.rationale: v0's GitHub integration gives version control (isolated branches, commits, PRs, CI checks) and a 'Duplicate Branch' feature that preserves prior commits, which supports versioning and reviewing generated code/projects, but this is git-based version control rather than a dedicated automation-versioning/rollback UI, and there's no explicit 'rollback to previous version' or audit-trail feature described. missing for 10: explicit one-click rollback/revert capability, dedicated review workflow beyond standard PRs, independent evidence of using this for rollback in practice.
